NW_OUTER_LAND.scope: Only explicit land-side cells north of the Wuwei gridded piedmont and the traced cliff/Great-Wall envelope; not the entire NW rectangle and NOT the connecting stream
observations: Wuwei (9,41), Anding (28,55), Tianshui (10,71) original city centres and odd-column half-row grid phase re-viewed.

The title occupies the outer arid plateau, separated from the continuous Wuwei piedmont grid by a drawn Great Wall and a continuous vertical scarp; the unoccluded plateau continues to the image north/west margin.
At the eastern plateau, rocky escarpments and closed upland islands were distinguished from the visibly connected pale stream. Stream centres are Q in the real map; mixed banks are not masked.
Absence of grid is supporting evidence only. The green administration line is explicitly excluded as a boundary determinant.
NW_OUTER_LAND.limit: Cartographic/visual boundary evidence, not an extracted original game enabled-hex table. Under title lettering the exterior material is a restrained arid surround (ESTIMATED), not a claim of exact original sand terrain.

SE_OUTER_SEA.scope: Explicit open seaward source cells east/south of the Huiji coastal escarpment; inlet/valley continuation is reviewed separately and restored as Q rather than hidden
observations: Huiji (184,125), Wu (182,109), Chaisang (126,133) and their local grid phases re-viewed; the seaward ridge and shore are followed through all three coastal crop views and the existing 25x25 review blocks.

Beyond the terminal Huiji-side grid there is a continuous steep coast facing a flat open seaward expanse that runs to the east/south image boundary. There are no ports, settlement footprints, development plots or roads in the approved expanse.

The coastline and ridge side, broad sea-to-image-edge continuation, city/port-side position and consistent local phase jointly delimit the visual exterior. Neither no-grid alone nor green administration lines are sufficient.
The 41 western inlet/valley candidates are NOT included by rectangle or connected VOID fill; their visible stream surfaces remain separate effective Q cells.
SE_OUTER_SEA.limit: This confirms the scoped cartographic exterior presentation, not all original navigation flags or all existing coarse-import non-VOID peripheral terrain. No existing valid tile is hidden/reclassified by this boundary.
